grant_type.description: The grant type for the token request.

client_id.description: The application ID registered in GitLab.

client_secret.description: The application secret. Required for confidential clients using authorization_code or refresh_token grant types.

code.description: The authorization code received from the authorize endpoint.

redirect_uri.description: The redirect URI used in the original authorization request.

code_verifier.description: The PKCE code verifier corresponding to the code_challenge.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token to exchange for a new access token.

device_code.description: The device code from the device authorization response.

username.description: Resource owner username. Only for password grant type.

password.description: Resource owner password. Only for password grant type.
